title: Free Yoneda sheaves agree with extension by zero of the localized unit
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and U an open. The module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the free O_X-presheaf on the representable of U is isomorphic to the module sheafification of the extension-by-zero presheaf [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf] of the unit module over the localized ring sheaf on X/U.

source.place: Tag 03DI, explicit direct-sum construction of extension by zero of the localized unit

proof.text: At each V both presheaves are the free O_X(V)-module on maps V to U. Identify each basis vector with the unit in the corresponding summand of the explicit direct sum. These linear maps have inverse given by finite linear combination and commute with restrictions, which compose the indices and restrict coefficients in both constructions. Apply module sheafification to the resulting presheaf isomorphism. The empty index case is the zero module.

lean.statement: theorem schemeModule_freeYoneda_iso (U : X.Opens) : Nonempty (((PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj)).obj ((PresheafOfModules.free (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj).obj (yoneda.obj U))) ≅ ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj)).obj ((SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroPresheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)))))
